newsitem.title: UK: Euro VGO softens on weak demand, lack of US trade.
newsitem.headline: Euro VGO softens on weak demand, lack of US trade.

text.p: European VGO markets were softer on Wednesday with little material available and only better quality fuel standing a chance of finding a home in the traditional U.S. outlets, traders said.
A cargo of low sulphur VGO was believed bought by a Swiss trader from a European refiner for an undisclosed price. Its final destination was unclear.
One Russian high sulphur VGO barge was heard traded at $126 cif, to a Dutch dealer.
Medium and high sulphur material was heard on offer start-May from a Spanish refiner.
Buyers were waiting for later May low sulphur material, due from Scandinavia, France and Spain, in the hope it would loosen up the market.

But with little demand, and the arb window to the U.S. shut for high and medium sulphur VGO, prices softened. For low sulphur the arb was only just possible, traders said. - London newsroom +44 171 542 8060
